title: Source/locale/glossary re-verification cadence + errata/withdrawal procedure
context: Sources, locale data (emergency numbers/protocols), and glossaries drift over time, so a documented re-verification cadence plus a versioning/errata/withdrawal procedure keeps delivered packs safe and recallable. A changed emergency number or revoked license must trigger withdrawal. It builds on sources-001 and locale-001.
objective: Document the re-verification cadence and the versioning/errata/withdrawal procedure for delivered packs.
acceptanceCriteria: Documents a cadence to re-verify allow-list sources and locale data (emergency numbers/protocols) via stored snapshots and to refresh glossaries
Defines the versioning + errata + withdrawal procedure (recall packs affected by a discovered defect or a license/locale change)
Ties into the source/locale-change watcher findings
Names responsibilities for executing the cadence
